title: Neither Adversarial Training Nor Purification: Emergent Adversarial Robustness from Oscillatory Predictive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.08683v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adversarial robustness in computer vision is still largely achieved through adversarial training or test-time adversarial purification, both of which introduce significant computational overhead by generating adversarial examples during training or performing iterative denoising at test time. We study whether empirical robustness can instead emerge from architectural and representation-learning inductive biases. We introduce Oscillatory Predictive Learning (OPL), a two-stage framework that combines Artificial Kuramoto Oscillatory Neurons (AKOrN) with predictive self-supervised pretraining using X-PhiNet. Because our default checkpoint uses randomized initial oscillator states, we compare it with other randomized adversarial defense methods that provide precise, reproducible, and strong attack protocols. translated_title: 既非对抗训练亦非净化：来自振荡预测学习的涌现对抗鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 计算机视觉中的对抗鲁棒性目前仍主要通过对抗训练或测试时对抗净化来实现，这两种方法都会引入显著的计算开销——前者需要在训练过程中生成对抗样本，后者需要在测试时执行迭代去噪。我们研究经验鲁棒性是否可以转而从架构和表示学习的归纳偏置中自然涌现。我们提出了振荡预测学习（OPL），这是一个两阶段框架，将人工Kuramoto振荡神经元（AKOrN）与使用X-PhiNet的预测性自监督预训练相结合。由于我们的默认检查点使用随机化的初始振荡器状态，我们将其与其他提供精确、可复现且强攻击协议的随机化对抗防御方法进行了比较。在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的实验，以及在CIFAR-10-C上的额外损坏评估表明，我们的方法实现了具有竞争力的（鲁棒性表现）。
tldr: 该论文提出振荡预测学习（OPL）框架，通过结合人工Kuramoto振荡神经元与预测性自监督预训练，使对抗鲁棒性从架构归纳偏置中自然涌现，从而无需昂贵的对抗训练或测试时净化即可在CIFAR-10/100上取得有竞争力的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Oscillatory Predictive Learning (OPL), which combines Artificial Kuramoto Oscillatory Neurons with predictive self-supervised pretraining to let adversarial robustness emerge naturally from architectural inductive biases, avoiding the heavy computational overhead of adversarial training or purification while achieving competitive robustness on CIFAR-10/100.
